postgres.note: Formerly vendored here as packages/postgres/flux-postgres (then briefly external as idris2-pg, then idris2-postgres); moved back to its own repo so it isn't Flux-only. See design/CONSOLIDATION.md.

postgres-async.note: Formerly packages/postgres/async/flux-postgres-pool; same repo/commit as postgres, different ipkg path. Depends on runtime below - a git dependency can only resolve its own deps against other globally-known collection/git packages, not a project-local alias.

runtime.note: Formerly vendored here as packages/runtime/flux-runtime, then briefly external as idris2-flux-async/flux-async (so postgres-async, an external git dependency, could resolve its own flux-async dependency); renamed there to runtime/runtime.ipkg since it has no Flux-specific dependencies, dropping the Flux.Async.*/Flux.Stream.* module prefix to Async.*/Stream.* along with it, same reasoning as db/postgres/docker. postgres-async's own dependency was updated to match - see that repo.

db.note: Formerly vendored here as packages/db/flux-db (Flux.DB.* modules); moved back out since it has no Flux-specific dependencies, and renamed db/DB.* along with the move. flux-db-flux (Flux.DB.PG/Flux.DB.Pool) stays - it's the genuinely Flux-specific HTTP-framework glue on top of this.

docker.note: Formerly vendored here as packages/docker/flux-docker; moved back out since it has no dependencies beyond Idris2 base. Had no prior git history to sync into (it was imported as a source snapshot, not a subtree).

iris.note: Formerly vendored here as packages/ui/flux-ui (Flux.UI.* modules); moved back out since it has no Flux-specific dependencies (ipkg depends only on contrib), reclaiming its own pre-Flux name - packages/ui was originally imported from a project called 'iris' (see design/CONSOLIDATION.md's history). Module prefix dropped back to Iris.*, and the public-facing runtime identifiers baked into the DOM/JS/native layers (#flux-ui-app, __fluxUI*, flux_ui_tui_*, etc.) were renamed to match (#iris-app, __iris*, iris_tui_*). flux-client and flux-mobile turned out to have the same property (no real dependency on flux, just flux-client, which itself only depends on iris/json-simple) and were later moved into this same repo as iris-client/iris-mobile sub-packages - see those entries below.

iris-client.note: Formerly vendored here as platform/flux-client (Flux.Platform.Client.* modules); moved out since it has no real Flux dependency - a portable typed JSON-RPC-over-HTTP client runtime for Iris apps, not coupled to Flux's server code. Same repo/commit as iris, different ipkg path. iris-mobile (formerly packages/mobile/flux-mobile, Flux.Mobile.* modules) moved to the same repo for the same reason, but - like 'capacitor' before it - is deliberately NOT registered here: nothing in this workspace's own build graph depends on it directly, only tools/mobile_check.py's own temporary pack map does (registering it here would make pack eagerly validate its capacitor dependency too, which isn't resolvable from this workspace).
